jobs.title: HPC Security Researcher
jobs.description: About the Role As an HPC Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in high-performance computing, software development in C/C++ or Rust/Python, backed by a minimum MSc in HPC, Scientific Computing, or related discipline. You have hands-on experience with SLURM, AI workloads, advanced algorithms, parallel computer architectures, Linux, network protocols in high performance computing. You excel at modeling HPC threats— resource exhaustion, lateral movement across compute nodes, Slurm exploits—and translating them into practical security defenses. You will be one of Haste's first HPC security researchers pioneering defenses for supercomputing clusters alongside AI and quantum workloads. Key Responsibilities Investigating Threat Actors & Attack Vectors: Identifying, analyzing, and documenting threats targeting HPC systems and ecosystem trends and developments. Developing Defenses and Mitigations: Designing detection logic and mitigation methods for HPC-specific threats that do not significantly degrade performance. Security Modeling: Developing threat models for HPC infrastructures with Cyber threat intelligence input in adjacent technologies to predict potential attack paths. Developing HPC-Specific Detection Rules: Authoring custom security rules for monitoring tools (e.g., SLURM, PBS) to detect abnormal user behavior, such as suspicious logins, resource usage, and data transfers. Engineering Collaboration - Translating HPC security research into production-grade detection requirements for Haste's threat engine and HPC integration. Documentation & Reporting- Creating technical reports, whitepapers, and proof-of-concept exploits to document vulnerabilities and share findings within the organization, to the public or conferences. Securing Heterogeneous Environments: Designing security for complex, hybrid platforms integrating cloud, AI/ML workflows, and on-premise, bare-metal hardware. Requirements University degree in a relevant field. Current residence in Germany

Notre Communauté rassemble à ce jour plus de 100 000 entreprises, 101 clubs départementaux et plus de 500 personnes mobilisées pour faire vivre le mouvement quotidiennement partout en France - avec pour ambition d’atteindre 150 000 entreprises d’ici 2027. Notre conviction est que l'entreprise, quelle que soit sa taille, a un rôle clé à jouer pour répondre aux grands défis sociaux, sociétaux et environnementaux de notre époque. Nous fédérons et favorisons le dialogue entre dirigeants d’entreprises engagées partout en France, grâce au 101 clubs départementaux. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Guardian
jobs.description: About the Team The Guardian team builds practical safety and oversight systems for increasingly capable AI agents. Our goal is to make it possible for agents to take on longer-running, higher-autonomy work while preserving meaningful safeguards, respecting user intent, and intervening when actions could cause serious or difficult-to-reverse harm. Auto-review is an early example of this work. When an agent reaches a permission boundary, a separate model evaluates the proposed action in context and determines whether it should proceed. The team is now extending this foundation into more capable oversight systems that account for richer user context, support a broader range of agent experiences, and integrate across OpenAI products. Guardian sits at the intersection of engineering, alignment research, product, infrastructure, and security. The team already has a strong engineering foundation in London and will continue to grow there as a concentrated, highly collaborative group. About the Role We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Guardian team in London. You will design and build production systems that evaluate agent behavior, identify risk, and take appropriate action without creating unnecessary friction for users. This is a hands-on engineering role with substantial technical depth and ownership. You will work across architecture, implementation, evaluation, and operations, taking projects from early exploration through production deployment. The work requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound product judgment, and comfort solving problems where both the requirements and the underlying technology are evolving. You will work closely with alignment researchers to translate emerging research into dependable systems, and with product and engineering teams to make agent safety a foundational capability across OpenAI. jobs.title: Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter
jobs.description: ABOUT FLOCK Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. jobs.description: Quality Assurance Engineer (Automation) The Role You’ll own the quality of the Lyrebird platform, from the first commit to the release gate. This is a hands-on, code-first engineering role, not manual test scripting. You’ll make our Playwright end-to-end and integration suites faster and more reliable, build contract tests that stop backend changes from silently breaking the web app, and design ways to evaluate clinical model output where exact-match assertions don’t work. You’ll also be the quality partner to our SRE function, giving them the health checks, synthetic monitors, load test results and post-deployment signals they need. When a release is ready to go, you’ll give a clear yes or no, backed by evidence. This role suits an engineer who sees testing as a craft and treats a test suite as production code. You’re comfortable moving between TypeScript and Python in the same day, you get real satisfaction from deleting a flaky test and cutting minutes off a pipeline, and you’d rather help other engineers write better tests than be the only person who writes them. You’ll enjoy the hard problem at the centre of this role: how to prove that non-deterministic AI output is safe and accurate enough for clinicians to rely on. About Us Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. jobs.title: AI Engineer l Young Talent Program
jobs.description: The rules of building are being rewritten. Come write them with us. Every few decades, the way companies are built gets reinvented from scratch. That is happening right now, and the people who learn to build in this new world first will define the next twenty years. Superstars are being made this year, not in ten. HelloPrint is a €100M+ e-commerce company serving businesses across Europe and the US. We are rebuilding the entire company as AI-first: our platform, customer service, operations, and how we design, price, sell, and deliver. Every piece of technology we run is being rewritten as we speak. We are doing it with a small, senior, very fast AI development team working shoulder to shoulder with our business leads. Now we are opening a handful of seats for young builders who want to grow faster than any graduate scheme, bootcamp, or big-tech ladder could ever let them. We don't care if you are 16, 25 or 30, whether you are self-taught, hacking in high school, or finishing a degree at TU Delft or TU/e—we care about what you have built and how fast you solve hard problems. The HelloPrint AI Residency is how you start. It is a permanent role from day one: your first year is a structured residency where you rotate across our most important AI projects, build alongside the team and learn at full speed. After that, you keep growing - in the direction where you have the most impact. What you will actually do: You will not get a training plan, a sandbox project or six months of shadowing. From week one, you build real things that real customers and colleagues use, on the projects that matter most to the company. You sit next to the founders, next to the engineers who are rebuilding our platform, and next to the business leads who own the outcomes. You get a lot of freedom and real responsibility, plus honest, direct guidance and feedback from people who have built this before. jobs.title: CDI - Sales Executive - Large Accounts
jobs.description: En rejoignant l’équipe Sales de Matera, tu auras l’opportunité d’échanger chaque jour avec des interlocuteurs très différents ! Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre ! Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente. Au sein de notre département Sales, tu retrouves : les SDR, dont l’objectif est de qualifier les prospects et d’organiser des démos avec les Sales Executive Sales Executive, dont l’objectif est d’accompagner les prospects sur la suite du cycle de vente jusqu’à la signature du contrat. Pour signer un contrat avec une copropriété, il faut obtenir la majorité des votes des copropriétaires lors de l'Assemblée Générale annuelle ( cycle de vente est long et complexe - 3 mois en moyenne). Onboarding et montée en compétences : Sur les 6 premiers mois : tu vas monter en compétences sur la qualification des leads, le pitch aux prospects inbound et outbound, les produits de Matera, l’accompagnement dans le changement de syndic pour tes clients, les techniques de vente et tu vas te familiariser avec le monde de la copropriété (droit et compta notamment). Ensuite : prise en main complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'à la signature des contrats - organisation et pitch lors des AG. Les avantages Les plus : Package : 45€ à 65K selon profil et expérience, 2 semaines d'onboarding pour comprendre le fonctionnement et les valeurs de Matera, et un onboarding spécifique à ton métier, Un career path pour t’accompagner dans ton évolution professionnelle : accompagnement hebdomadaire par taon manager, 2 performances reviews par an, et politique de mobilité interne, Politique de rémunération et de BSPCEs transparente, Politique d’accompag

jobs.description: About the Role We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the DACH market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up. First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out how we win in DACH: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue. You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through. Your 12-Month Journey First 3 months: Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in DACH. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals. Within 6 months: Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the DACH market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product. After 1 year: Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in DACH, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up. Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time): Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Der Reiseanteil liegt bei rund 10 bis maximal 15 Prozent. ​ Das Unternehmen Unser Kunde ist eine etablierte, europäisch aufgestellte Dienstleistungsgruppe mit Landesgesellschaften in einem guten Dutzend Ländern, mehr als 10.000 Beschäftigten und über einer halben Milliarde Euro Umsatz. Das Geschäft lebt von Daten, Prozessen und schnellen Entscheidungen, also genau dort, wo KI den größten Hebel hat. Deshalb baut sich die Gruppe gerade von Grund auf neu: kein Pilot in einer Abteilung, sondern ein Umbau von Organisation, Produkt und Arbeitsweise über alle Länder hinweg. Das große Transformationsprogramm startet jetzt, und du bist von Anfang an dabei. Dahinter stehen ein neu aufgestelltes Leadership-Team, ein CTO, der selbst aus der Top-Beratung kommt, und ein langfristig denkender Eigentümer. Ein eigenes Plattformteam entwickelt bereits die KI-Anwendung und erste Agenten, und mit dem neuen Innovation Hub bekommt die Transformation ihren eigenen Ort. Die beste KI-Anwendung bringt allerdings wenig, solange sie nur in der Zentrale funktioniert. Ob die Transformation gelingt, entscheidet sich im Alltag der Landesgesellschaften, und genau dort setzt diese Rolle an. ​ Deine Aufgaben Du berichtest direkt an den CTO, arbeitest Hand in Hand mit dem Produktteam und bringst die eigene KI-Anwendung in die Länder. jobs.title: AI Security Researcher
jobs.description: About the Role As an AI Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in AI/ML security, software development in Python, backed by a minimum MSc in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related discipline. You have hands-on experience with AI workloads, large language models, training frameworks, advanced optimization algorithms, GPU clusters, and ideally SLURM in HPC environments. You excel at modeling AI threats—model/data poisoning, permission escalation, backdoors, data drift attacks, prompt injection—and translating them into practical security defenses. You will be one of Haste's first AI security researchers pioneering defenses for trillion-parameter AI training environments alongside HPC and quantum workloads. Key Responsibilities Adversarial Threat Research: Investigating emerging attack vectors and developing techniques to uncover vulnerabilities in AI models, data pipelines, and infrastructure. Threat Modeling & Risk Analysis: Mapping and characterizing potential threats across the AI lifecycle—from data ingestion to deployment—to prioritize security investments. Developing Defenses & Guardrails: Designing and implementing detection logic and researching mitigation methods to AI threats. Collaborating with Engineering Teams: Translating research findings into actionable, production-grade security requirements for product teams, ensuring threat detection makes sense. Documentation & Reporting: Creating technical reports, whitepapers, and proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits to document vulnerabilities and share findings within the organization or to the public. Monitoring AI Ecosystem Trends: Staying updated on the latest AI security standards, frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS), and academic research. Requirements University degree in AI/ML or relevant discipline. Current residence in Germany or Austria. Full-time availability from December 1, 2026, remote from Germany or Austria only. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures . To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram . About the role Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US. As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

About the Role: We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented Manager, Production Planning to lead the planning team responsible for our non-sterile compounded production. This position manages and develops the site's production planners and owns the forward-looking production plan. The plan converts demand forecasts and inventory policy into a rolling view of the next several weeks through the next year or more, tests that plan against labor, equipment, and material capacity, and identifies where the business cannot meet it. The Manager then drives the response to each gap, whether through training, labor, or capital investment, and hands the plan to Production Scheduling for on-site execution. The ideal candidate is a proactive people leader with a strong understanding of integrated planning systems, supply chain dynamics, and cross-functional collaboration across the operations planning team. jobs.title: Product Manager - Strategic Partner Integrations (regular travel to Bay Area)
jobs.description: About Supabase Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. More than 10 million developers build on it, from solo founders shipping over a weekend to teams and builders via Vercel, Lovable and Stripe, and every one of them reaches Supabase through a surface: an API, an auth flow, an SDK, or a Partner's product with Supabase integrated. The current and next wave of software leans on those surfaces harder than any before it. Agents now act on behalf of developers and end users, authentication has to work machine-to-machine as seamlessly as it once worked human-to-human, and independent platforms increasingly need to authenticate, delegate, and coordinate with each other without a person in the loop. For a platform built on Postgres with Auth, Compute, Storage and generated Data APIs at its core, the surfaces where Supabase meets Partners and their systems are some of the most important avenues that we own - this role owns these surfaces. This role owns a focused portfolio of those Partners. Not the platform as a whole, but a small number of strategic Partners whose integrations you are accountable for making excellent. Success here is a product measure, not a commercial one: the integration is high quality, the developers who use it are well served, and it keeps improving. That means living close to those developers, obsessing over where the integration fails them, and turning what you learn into the roadmap. It is a product and engineering job first, because the best integrations are won in architecture reviews and pull requests, not in meetings. jobs.description: What is PerfectServe ? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. jobs.title: Account Executive, Enterprise
jobs.description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. jobs.description: FEQ128R99 Location: Germany (remote or from a Databricks office – anywhere in Germany) Languages: Fluent German and business-level English At Databricks, we build the platform that makes data and AI usable across an entire organization. More and more of our customers in Germany – public sector, critical infrastructure (KRITIS), financial services, healthcare, defence and industry – need to keep control over where their data lives and who can access it. They want the full power of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform without giving up data residency, jurisdictional control or the option to switch providers. As a Solutions Architect for Digital Sovereignty, you are the technical lead for this motion in Germany. You design sovereign data and AI architectures with customers, run proofs of concept end to end, and help our sovereign cloud partners and account teams turn a proven pattern into production workloads. The impact you will have Act as the trusted technical advisor on digital sovereignty for strategic and regulated customers across Germany, from the first conversation with the CIO/CISO through to production. Design and validate sovereign reference architectures Run complex proofs of concept and pilots – performance, scalability, security and network connectivity tests with different data volumes – and translate the results into clear go/no-go recommendations. Work hand in hand with sovereign cloud and storage partners: joint solution design, enablement of partner technical teams, co-selling and joint customer workshops. Position Databricks clearly in the sovereignty discussion – CLOUD Act, GDPR, NIS2, DORA, BSI C5, EU Data Act, open formats and exit strategies – and articulate how our open architecture reduces lock-in compared with competing approaches. Feed field requirements back to Databricks Product and Engineering, and collaborate with Legal, Security and Compliance on customer questions. Build repeatable assets: reference architectures, demos, PoC play

jobs.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the  FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from  more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require.  Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Nous créons le poste de Finance Manager pour fiabiliser et automatiser la comptabilité, la facturation et le reporting, aux côtés de notre CFO. Qui sommes-nous ? Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais, conçu pour l’IA et hébergé en Europe, avec des datacenters à Paris et à Lyon. Notre propre infrastructure GPU permet à des startups, des chercheurs et des entreprises de déployer leurs modèles en quelques minutes, dans le respect du RGPD et jusqu’à 70 % moins cher qu’avec un hyperscaler. Notre ambition : bâtir un acteur européen de référence de l’infrastructure IA. Pourquoi ce poste ? Arkane Cloud passe de 10 à 50 personnes d’ici fin 2027 et prépare des étapes structurantes : organisation de ses activités et financement de son infrastructure GPU. Pour réussir, il faut des comptes fiables chaque mois, une facturation automatisée et un reporting lisible par des investisseurs. Rattaché(e) au CFO, vous êtes son point d’appui au quotidien, sur nos deux activités. Vos missions • Piloter la clôture mensuelle, pour des comptes livrés en J+10. • Fiabiliser le chiffre d’affaires Cloud : facturation à l’heure, capacité GPU réservée, prépaiements. • Structurer puis automatiser les processus finance, avec un objectif clair : 90 % des flux automatisés, 10 % de validation manuelle. • Consolider le reporting du groupe, avec une vision claire du Cloud et du Négoce. • Éclairer les décisions stratégiques du CFO et accompagner les projets structurants : financements, data rooms, futur audit. jobs.title: Founding Engineer - Ambient Care Startup
jobs.description: Stage: Pre-seed. Location: Cambridge/London, UK. Comp: Competitive + Equity About Subtle Most families find out something's wrong too late: a fall, a missed check-in, a change no one noticed until it became a crisis. We're building ambient sensing for the elderly and vulnerable at home, technology that quietly looks out for the people we love without asking them to wear anything or change how they live. We're early. We're validating with real customers, building the first hardware, and looking for the person who'll help turn this from an idea into a product families can trust with something this personal. We are building this from scratch inside Founders Factory's studio, with a dedicated pre-seed investment, hands-on studio support across product, design, talent and growth, and a six-month build programme to get from concept to a fundable, in-market product. This venture has secured a major European technology partner. The founding CEO is already in place. We are now looking for the technical other half of the founding team. The role You'll be our first engineering hire, working directly with the founder(s) and carrying real authority over what we build and how. It's a hands-on role that spans hardware and software, and a leadership one too, since you'll grow the team that follows you. Responsibilities Own hardware validation and bench testing end to end, and lead our manufacturing path. Whether that ends up being an outsourced partner or in-house, you're the one validating the sensor platform yourself and making sure whatever we ship has been properly tested before it reaches someone's home. This is safety-relevant, so you'd rather catch a failure on the bench than have it happen in someone's home. Build the software that turns sensor data into something useful. Detection logic, alerting, and the escalation decisions that sit behind them, tested and monitored with the same rigor as the hardware. Navigate the regulatory and security requirements that come with this

jobs.description: Akur8 is one of the leading providers of insurance pricing and rating technology. Our mission is to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk. Our SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and rating technology to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems. Insurers use it to model and rate risk up to 10x faster while keeping transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust. As the product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform for pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions. Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in: CB Insights' Insurtech 50 (2025) CNBC's InsurTech Top 150 (2025) InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025) Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025) Akur8 has 50+ nationalities across 8 global offices and serves 420+ clients across 4 continents. We’re an equal opportunities employer, and we value the different perspectives that help shape better products and decisions. Deploy is Akur8’s stateless rating engine, delivering subsecond insurance premium computations across a wide range of industry use cases. It sits at the intersection of two key functions in insurance. Actuaries extract insights from data and make the statistical decisions that shape the business. IT teams, in turn, build and maintain the reliable systems that put those decisions into production. Today, these two worlds operate with different skills, priorities and tools, connected through slow, manual handoffs between teams. Deploy replaces this process with a shared foundation that aligns actuarial and IT teams and reduces time-to-market. Building it requires a deep understanding of how both functions are organised, what each is trying to achieve, and the complex ecosystem behind an insurance product and its pricing. jobs.title: Product Engineering Lead
jobs.description: Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix. At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires. I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves. Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week. That means a top-notch engineer who leads from the codebase. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You'll ship every week and lead the team's biggest technical work — and as the team grows, you'll grow into managing it. You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win. — Grigory Why Secfix exists Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work. Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with hubs in Munich, Berlin and London. We’re a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader. We’ve just raised our $12M Series A and are backed by top VCs, including Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. This role sits at the intersection of compliance delivery, content, and team support. You'll own the compliance knowledge that lives inside our platform, run internal audits, support our customer success team, and act as the compliance voice for customers, auditors, and product. You'll work closely with our co-founder & CISO and our CS Lead. jobs.title: Country Lead - France
jobs.description: Got Drive? Join AnyVan as we make moving anything, anywhere miles better and build a career that moves just as fast. Back in 2009, our Chairman Angus saw half-empty vans everywhere and knew there had to be a better way! That's how AnyVan began. He set out to create the world's most efficient logistics technology and help halve the number of wasted miles by filling those empty vans. Since then we've become the nation's favourite way to move, with over 150k five-star reviews and 5 million customers in the UK and Europe. Our team of 400 AnyVanners across London, Cape Town and Bogota is proving that moving doesn't have to cost the earth by helping save 8,520 tonnes of Carbon each year. We’re looking for a French Markets Guru to own and scale AnyVan’s marketing and growth in one of our most important expansion markets. Reporting to the CMO, you’ll define and execute the French go‑to‑market strategy, working closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, Pricing and Operations. This is a high‑impact, high‑ownership role: you’ll combine sharp strategic thinking with hands‑on execution, bringing deep local market insight and broad channel expertise to acquire customers, improve conversion and accelerate revenue growth. It’s fast‑paced, opportunity‑rich, and ideal for someone who loves building from the ground up. What you'll do: Scale fast - Build on the playbooks from our successful Spain launch to rapidly grow France. jobs.description: About Customer.io Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Our team is six product managers who partner closely with Design and Engineering to launch first-class products that drive customer and business outcomes. You need to be able to synthesize customer research, market research, analytics and your own taste into a customer-first roadmap and set of releases. Lead cross-functional planning by aligning Engineering, Design, and business stakeholders around clear product goals and trade-offs. Drive feature strategy and influence roadmaps by proposing initiatives rooted in customer impact and market opportunity. Break down complex projects into incremental, testable releases, using component reuse and system thinking to accelerate delivery. Define product success metrics upfront and track adoption, engagement, and retention

jobs.description: Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines (H/F) Poste en CDD de 4,5 mois, basé à Brest, sur le port de commerce. Depuis plus de 75 ans, Maritime Kuhn est un acteur incontournable du monde portuaire Français. Grâce à ses agences locales et à l’expertise de près de 800 collaborateurs, Maritime Kuhn propose une gamme complète de services aux navires et aux activités portuaires. Dans le cadre d’un remplacement pour congé paternité, la société Maritime Kuhn Services recherche un(e) Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines, en CDD, à partir du lundi 14 décembre 2026 jusqu’au vendredi 30 avril 2027. Le service ressources humaines du pôle de Brest (près de 150 collaborateurs) assure la gestion opérationnelle RH des sociétés implantées à Concarneau, Saint-Brieuc, Saint-Malo, Cherbourg et Brest. Vos missions Rattaché(e) à la Responsable des Ressources Humaines, vous participez au déploiement de la politique ressources humaines dans un environnement multisite. Véritable relais opérationnel, vous assurez la gestion quotidienne des activités ressources humaines et le suivi autonome des dossiers confiés, après validation de votre responsable. À ce titre, vos principales missions sont : · Administration du personnel et paie : préparer les éléments variables de paie en lien avec le cabinet comptable, gérer les dossiers des collaborateurs de leur embauche à leur départ et élaborer les tableaux de bord sociaux. · Formation et compétences : assurer le suivi des formations, des relations avec les organismes et des demandes de financement auprès des OPCO. · Droit social et protection sociale : veiller au respect de la réglementation, gérer le suivi des visites médicales, des absences et des dossiers de mutuelle, prévoyance et retraite. · Recrutement : participer à l'identification des besoins, à la diffusion des offres et à la sélection des candidats. · Relations sociales et communication RH : contribuer à la préparation des réunions avec les représentants du personnel, au suivi des obligations sociales

jobs.description: Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one. Customers and users across the globe use Planet s data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles. As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains. We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands. You will collaborate directly with customers, engineers, and cross-functional teams, progressively developing the technical and consulting skills required to become a trusted technical advisor. jobs.title: Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer - Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
jobs.description: eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future. We are looking for a Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and own the real-time firmware that turns our control electronics into a working quantum computer. You will work on our next-generation system, where the control electronics are being integrated into a single, highly integrated chip. You sit at the heart of the machine, between the hardware that generates the pulses and the higher-level software that describes the experiments. Timing is not a detail here; it is the product. You are the person who makes sure the right signal reaches the ions at the right nanosecond, reliably, run after run. Responsibilities: Own the embedded firmware on our ARM-based control platform, from architecture through implementation to on-hardware debugging Develop and maintain the real-time software layer that coordinates pulse sequencing, timing, and data flow across our highly integrated control chip Write and maintain the low-level drivers and board support the hardware relies on Guarantee deterministic, low-latency behaviour under hard real-time constraints Lead firmware bring-up together with our electronics and physics teams, and debug at the boundary where software meets signal Define the firmware architecture and engineering practices — build, test, and release processes for the embedded layer as the system matures Contribute to the interfaces between the embedded layer and the rest of the stack, so experiments defined in software run correctly on the machine

jobs.title: wo-stage onderzoek milieukosten m.b.v. bestaande afval- en emissiestatistieken
jobs.description: wo- afstudeerstage/praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige onderzoeker die energie krijgt van data, duurzaamheid en nieuwe inzichten? Wil jij een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan de statistieken van het CBS? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het kabinet wil dat Nederland in 2050 volledig circulair is. Om te kunnen volgen of we die doelstelling halen, is betrouwbare informatie nodig over onder andere afval en emissies naar water. Het CBS verzamelt en publiceert deze gegevens voor bedrijven. Daarbij maken we vooral gebruik van gegevens uit het elektronisch Milieujaarverslag (e-MJV), aangevuld met enquêtes. Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig? Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. Je combineert bijvoorbeeld gegevens over de hoeveelheid afval en geloosd water met bestaande indicatoren, zoals gemiddelde kosten per ton afval en sectorspecifieke kosten per kubieke meter geloosd water. Je gaat onder andere: bestaande data en indicatoren analyseren en beoordelen op bruikbaarheid; onderzoeken welke methode het meest geschikt is om de milieukosten te schatten; een berekening of model ontwikkelen waarmee de kosten kunnen worden afgeleid; de uitkomsten vergelijken met de beschikbare gegevens uit de huidige enquête; onderzoeken hoe betrouwbaar en bruikbaar de schattingen zijn; je bevindingen vertalen naar een concreet advies voor het CBS. Met jouw onderzoek willen we bepalen of we meer uit bestaande data kunnen halen en minder hoeven uit te vragen bij bedrijven. Als blijkt dat de milieukosten betrouwbaar kunnen worden berekend, kunnen de uitkomsten bovendien worden gebruikt om de bestaande afval- en waterstatistieken te controleren. jobs.title: wo-stage woningmarkt onderzoek: verhuisketens, doorstroom en ouderenwoningen
jobs.description: wo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die analytische wo-student die nieuwsgierig is naar de doorstroom op de woningmarkt? Krijg je energie van onderzoek doen, werken met data en programmeren in R? Wil je jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden inzetten voor een actueel maatschappelijk vraagstuk? Dit is jouw uitdaging Verhuisketens geven inzicht in de doorstroom op de woningmarkt en zijn daardoor actueel en relevant. Het CBS heeft een methode ontwikkeld om deze ketens in beeld te brengen. Het dashboard Verhuisketens in Nederland toont onder meer de gemiddelde lengte van een verhuisketen. Er is echter nog veel ruimte voor verdieping. Tijdens deze stage kun je afstudeeronderzoek doen naar de rol van ouderenwoningen in de doorstroom op de huizenmarkt. Je kunt daarin op zoek gaan naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen: In hoeverre draagt het bouwen van ouderenwoningen bij aan de doorstroom op de woningmarkt? Wat is de invloed van vergrijzing en overlijden van ouderen op de doorstroom en het woningaanbod? Heb je zelf een goede onderzoeksvraag die aansluit bij dit thema, dan is daar ook ruimte voor. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag De afdeling Beleidsstatistiek bestaat uit 70 collega’s verdeeld over Den Haag en Heerlen. Er werken onderzoekers en projectleiders met veel verschillende studieachtergronden binnen onze afdeling. Wij stellen cijfers samen die gebruikt worden voor het ontwikkelen, monitoren en verbeteren van beleid, vaak met een thema-overstijgend karakter. jobs.title: Senior Fleet Manager
jobs.description: Ben jij een vooruitdenker die complexe data moeiteloos vertaalt naar glashelder advies? Neem jij van nature de regie, ben je sterk in stakeholdermanagement en heb je affiniteit met de dynamische wereld van Schiphol? Lees dan snel verder! Binnen Orion Fleet Management zijn we op zoek naar een proactieve Senior Fleet Manager met een specifieke focus op onze klant Schiphol en ons label AirportPartners. Waar een reguliere Fleet Manager sterk leunt op de dagelijkse operatie, sta jij als Senior Fleet Manager daarboven. Jij kijkt verder dan de waan van de dag, anticipeert op wat komen gaat en gebruikt keiharde data om onze klant op strategisch niveau te adviseren. Wat ga je doen? In de rol van Senior Fleet Manager ben jij de absolute eigenaar van de vlootbeschikbaarheid voor Schiphol. Met ons label AirportPartners beheren wij hier de unieke en bedrijfskritische vloot van Schiphol: van de brandweerwagens en de onmisbare sneeuwvloot tot de personenwagens van het KLM-personeel. Jouw werk draait niet om achteraf reageren, maar om proactief sturen. Omdat jij de operationele basis feilloos begrijpt en beheerst, kun jij de vertaalslag maken naar optimalisatie en strategisch partnership. Jouw takenpakket als Senior Fleet Manager bestaat uit de volgende pijlers: Datagedreven Regie & Strategie: Proactieve advisering: Je wacht niet tot de klant belt met een probleem, maar je adviseert hen ongevraagd over rendementsverbetering en risicobeperking op basis van jouw data-analyses; Datagedreven regie: Je gebruikt voorspellende data om de vloot optimaal in te zetten en stilstand te minimaliseren. Vooruitdenken is jouw tweede natuur; Bewaking van SLA’s en KPI’s: Je monitort continu de prestaties, stuurt bij waar nodig en garandeert dat we onze beloftes aan de klant waarmaken (of overtreffen); Rapportage en overleg: Je zit regelmatig aan tafel met het management van klanten en leveranciers. Je presenteert heldere rapportages en treedt op als een volwaardig en strategisch gesprekspartner. Ope

jobs.location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France
jobs.description: Intégrez le Département Hydrogéologie du Groupe Fondasol et mettez votre expertise au service de projets innovants alliant technique et développement durable. Pour accompagner notre équipe, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Hydrogéologue F/H pour renforcer notre équipe d'ingénieurs. Vos missions au quotidien En tant qu' Ingénieur Hydrogéologue , vous piloterez des projets d'aménagement et de gestion des eaux souterraines, de l'étude initiale à la présentation des résultats pour tous types de projets ( espaces publics, bâtiments industriels, tertiaires, résidentiels, ouvrages souterrains, etc.) . Vos missions consisteront à : Elaborer des devis en tenant compte des besoins de votre client Mener/piloter des campagnes de terrain pour l’acquisition des caractéristiques géologiques et hydrogéologiques de sites (essai de pompage, essai d’infiltration, traçages, prélèvements d’échantillons, etc.) en lien avec les Technicien Multi-Métiers. Réaliser des études en lien avec les eaux souterraines pour des projets variés comme l’estimation des niveaux caractéristiques de nappe, le calcul des débits de pompage/épuisement en phase travaux, le suivi de travaux de rabattement, , les problématiques de gestion des eaux pluviales, les études géothermiques (aquathermie et champ de sondes), etc. Concevoir des solutions techniques pour la gestion des eaux comme par exemple, des systèmes de rabattement de nappe, puits d’infiltration ou de recharge, bassins de rétention et ou infiltration d’eaux pluviales, ou encore des systèmes de drainage. Rédiger des rapports techniques et présenter vos conclusions aux équipes de projets (MOA/MOE/AMO) et autorités (DREAL, DDT(M)). Travailler en synergie avec les expertises du Groupe (géotechniques, environnementales, géophysiques, …) pour proposer des offres complètes et identifier de nouvelles opportunités. Contribuez développement commercial en proposant l’ensemble de nos expertises et solutions innovantes en hydrogéologie, géothermie et stockage de déche

As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. jobs.title: Data, Automatisation & IA – Investissement à impact
jobs.description: L’investissement à impact est un secteur d’activité en forte croissance. INCO Ventures, acteur clé de ce domaine en France, gère et conseille six fonds d’investissement dédiés au financement des entreprises à fort impact social et/ou environnemental. Il investit principalement dans des cibles en changement d’échelle et/ou en développement (tickets d’investissement compris entre 300k€ et 2M€). Pourquoi nous recrutons Nous sommes une société de gestion spécialisée dans l’investissement à impact. Nous accompagnons des entreprises qui contribuent aux grandes transitions environnementales et sociales, tout en recherchant une performance financière attractive pour nos investisseurs. Au fil des années, nous avons construit nos outils et nos processus autour d’Airtable, de différentes solutions SaaS et d’usages ponctuels de l’intelligence artificielle. Cette organisation nous a permis de grandir rapidement. Aujourd’hui, nous souhaitons franchir une nouvelle étape. Notre ambition est de construire une véritable plateforme data et IA au service de l’ensemble de notre écosystème : L’équipe de gestion Les équipes middle office et conformité Nos investisseurs (LPs) Les entreprises de notre portefeuille Concrètement, nous souhaitons faire évoluer notre architecture de données, automatiser davantage nos processus, déployer des usages IA à forte valeur ajoutée et créer des espaces digitaux permettant à chacun d’accéder simplement aux informations dont il ou elle a besoin. Pour nous accompagner dans cette transformation, nous recrutons un.e stagiaire qui travaillera directement avec le Responsable Conformité & Middle Office ainsi qu’un.e Directeur.rice d’investissement. Ce stage est autant un projet de construction qu’un projet d’innovation : nous recherchons une personne capable de comprendre les enjeux métier, de proposer des solutions et de contribuer à leur mise en œuvre. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
